caption: The drawing consists of a grid of nine square blocks, each composed of concentric rectangular strips arranged in a geometric, log-cabin quilt pattern. The strips within each block vary in color and pattern, including shades of red, brown, beige, black, blue, green, yellow, and white. Some strips are solid colors, while others feature stripes, checkers, plaids, and floral or abstract designs. The central piece in each block is typically a small square, often red or black, surrounded by different colored bands. The blocks are bordered and separated by strips that carry both muted and bright tones, with a mix of horizontal, vertical, and diagonal orientations. The entire composition is set against a cream-colored background, with the colored grid centralized on the page.
title: Quilted Pieces - Squares
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
